title: Filter boards by assignee
details: Choose an assignee to focus a board on their tasks. The filter is saved per browser, not shared with teammates.

title: Keep task order after reconnecting
details: Reconnecting after a brief network outage no longer resets manually sorted tasks.

title: Rename the export status column
details: CSV exports now use status instead of state as the column header. Update scripts that read the state column before importing new exports.

title: Schedule recurring tasks
details: Still in development; not available in this release.

title: Archive completed boards
details: Move completed boards out of the active board list. No migration is required.
